items.title: Promote the multi-model ablation protocol into canonical project docs
items.context: Move the reviewed protocol from the Claude output path into docs/requirements/decisions with the M0 execution order, model/host constraints, parallel runner rules, budget-lock ordering, and research-only claim boundary preserved.

happy.desc: Protocol exists in canonical docs and contains M0/M1/M2 ordering plus E1/E2 host-model separation.

edge.desc: The protocol explicitly says Codex CLI audit output is not ablation outcome unless registered as a formal runner.

adversarial.desc: The protocol forbids ② vs ④ as confirmatory evidence and blocks research evidence from product gate/playbook/runtime use.

items.userSees: User sees docs/requirements/decisions/multi-model-ablation-replication.md in the canonical repo docs with M0 ordering, host/model constraints, runner inclusion rules, budget-lock ordering, and research-only claim boundaries preserved.

items.title: Add M0 cell manifest and runner registry examples
items.context: Create lightweight experiment artifacts that show how formal runners are assigned cellKeys before execution, including hostKind versus model snapshot separation.

happy.desc: Examples include ③, ⑥, ②, optional ④ cells with unique cellKeys and runner assignments.

edge.desc: A runner can be Codex CLI, Codex App, CI, or custom harness while model family is determined only by executorSnapshot and reviewerSnapshot.

adversarial.desc: The examples do not duplicate a cellKey across runners or assign A2 prime before budgetLockDigest is present.

items.userSees: User sees experiments/multi-model-ablation/cell-manifest.example.json and runner-registry.example.json with unique cellKeys and host/model identity separated.

items.title: Add A2 prime budget-lock readiness artifact
items.context: Define the phase1-budget-lock artifact shape so M0 freezes the A4 calibration-before-A2-prime rule before Phase 1 can start.

happy.desc: The example records executorFamily, task-level A4 calibration medians, snapshot digests, and budgetLockDigest.

edge.desc: The artifact makes A2 prime impossible to treat as valid before budget lock.

adversarial.desc: The artifact disallows post hoc budget edits after A2 prime outcomes are known.

items.userSees: User sees experiments/multi-model-ablation/phase1-budget-lock.example.json showing that A2 prime rows require a prior A4-derived budget lock digest.

items.title: Add a read-only M0 readiness checker or documented check command
items.context: Provide a lightweight verification path that checks the protocol and examples for required fields without calling providers or running Phase 1 cells.

happy.desc: A maintainer can verify M0 readiness locally with deterministic file checks.

edge.desc: The check distinguishes protocol audit evidence from formal ablation outcome evidence.

adversarial.desc: The check fails or documents failure if A2 prime cells appear without a budget lock or if Codex CLI is treated as a model family.

items.userSees: User sees experiments/multi-model-ablation/README.md with provider-free local checks for protocol, manifest, runner registry, and budget-lock readiness.
